8. Therefore, the bail application filed by the petitioners is allowed.
They (petitioners) are allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(rupees fifty thousand) with two solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with conditions that :-
(i) they (petitioners) shall not involve with similar nature of crime in future;
 (ii) the petitioner No.2-Bhimsen Nayak shall  furnish cash security to the tune of Rs.10,00,000/- (rupees ten lakh) and the petitioner No.1-Manmath Keshari Pattanaik shall furnish cash security to the tune of Rs.5,00,000/-
(rupees five lakh) only in the shape of S.T.D.Rs. obtained from any Nationalized Bank initially for a period of 6 months renewable from time to time till final disposal of the case with undertakings by the respective petitioners that, the payment of the matured amount as against the respective S.T.D.Rs. shall be subject to orders passed under BNSS, 2023 including an order under Section 395 of the BNSS, 2023 by the Trial Court;
(iii) they shall appear before the Trial Court personally in each date of adjournment of the case without fail till the conclusion of trial;
(iv) they shall not terrorize, coerce, influence or threat any witnesses of the prosecution including the informant and his family members either directly or indirectly in any manner whatsoever at any stage of the proceeding of the case; but in case of their failure to comply any of the aforesaid conditions, the Court in seisin over the matter is authorized to cancel their respective bail orders )
